data.summary: Results-oriented Business Analyst with 4+ years of experience in requirement gathering, stakeholder management, KPI definition, and business reporting across BFSI and consulting environments. Proven ability to translate complex business needs into actionable analytical solutions, partnering with cross- functional teams including Sales, Operations, Finance, and Product to deliver data-driven decision support and process improvement. Skilled in documenting BRDs, FRDs, and user stories; facilitating UAT; and building automated Power BI, Tableau, and Excel dashboards that improve reporting efficiency and enable self-service analytics for senior leadership. Strong communicator with a continuous improvement mindset, experienced in Agile delivery environments and managing multiple priorities in fast-paced, deadline-driven settings.

Skilled in documenting BRDs, FRDs, and user stories; facilitating UAT; and building automated Power BI, Tableau, and Excel dashboards that improve reporting efficiency and enable self-service analytics for senior leadership. Strong communicator with a continuous improvement mindset, experienced in Agile delivery environments and managing multiple priorities in fast-paced, deadline-driven settings.

WORK EXPERIENCE
SG Analytics (A Straive Company), Pune Associate Analyst • • Work closely with senior managers and stakeholders to elicit business requirements, understand reporting needs, and translate them into actionable
Jan 2023 – Present Apr 2024 – Present
Promoted internally from consultant based on performance and expanded ownership across reporting and business analysis initiatives.






dashboards and automated reports in Power BI and Excel. Document functional requirements and reporting logic; prepare BRDs/user stories to ensure clear understanding and smooth handoffs to the development team. Identify manual reporting bottlenecks and design automation solutions using Excel (macros and templates), reducing weekly manual effort by -35% and improving consistency across multiple teams. Facilitate KPI definition workshops with cross-functional stakeholders; establish KPI frameworks, definitions, and build KPI tracking dashboards to drive data-backed decision making. Support UAT for reports and dashboards by validating requirements, logging defects, coordinating sign-offs with stakeholders, and maintaining version change logs and documentation. Collaborate with data and engineering teams to improve data pipelines through logic fixes and optimization, reducing processing time by -40% and improving report reliability and data availability. Build interactive dashboards and self-service reporting solutions that enable business users to access insights independently, reducing report turnaround time from 2-3 days to near real-time.
Consultant • Worked with clients across FMCG, retail, and financial services to understand reporting needs and build dashboards used by business teams. • • •
Jan 2023 – Mar 2024
Discussed requirements with stakeholders and converted them into reports and dashboards to improve visibility and tracking Used SQL, Power BI, and Tableau to prepare reports and support day-to-day business decisions. Created reporting documents and coordinated with internal teams to ensure timely delivery.
NatWest Group, Pune Reporting Analyst •
Sep 2021 – Dec 2022
Supported finance and operations teams with monthly reporting using Excel and SQL; ensured accuracy and timely delivery of reports, reducing the reporting cycle from 5 days to 3 days through process and data improvements. Built Power BI dashboards for teams to monitor key metrics and trends, replacing manual email-based updates and enabling quicker visibility for managers. Performed data quality checks, reconciliations, and process documentation to support audit queries and maintain data integrity. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to standardize reporting processes and improve data accuracy across business functions.

•
KEY WINS
• • •
Reduced a weekly manual reporting process from ~8 hours to under 2 hours using Excel automation, adopted across multiple teams. Built dashboards for 5+ Agile projects that replaced slide decks in leadership updates, saving time and reducing last-minute data requests. Reduced data processing time from 5 hours to 3 hours by improving SQL queries and reporting workflows Enabled self-service reporting for business teams, reducing report turnaround time from 2–3 days to near real-time.
